name: Aeris Alis
source:
Aeris Alis is a melancholic denpa visual novel about Elise, a high school girl who suddenly grew wings one day that are functionally useless. She goes through her ordinary life with Inori, her best friend, until one day she is caught up in an investigation surrounding strange, chaotic disappearances. Knowing her life is threatened, Elise and Inori team up with Alicia, another girl with powers, to try and put a stop to it all. 

...Can three girls really solve this case by themselves?

[From [url=https://fluffyblessing.itch.io/aeris-alis]itch.io[/url]]
